intro: Compare a personal message with a simple booking confirmation and find dates and conditions.
b1.texto: Routine messages often make the purpose clear in the first line. Check names, dates, times and any action the reader must take. A confirmation may describe what is booked without explaining every cancellation condition; look for a separate policy if the text refers to one.
b2.f0: Hi, Marta: I have the tickets for Saturday the 18th. The show starts at 7:30. Shall we meet in front of the theatre at seven?
b2.f1: If you cannot arrive on time, send me a message and I will wait for you inside.
b3.f0: Dear Ms Vega: we confirm the booking of a double room for two nights, from 18 to 20 July.
b3.f1: Breakfast is included. Your booking reference is M4821. To request a change, reply to this email before 10 July.
b5.pregunta: What time does the theatre show start?
b5.o0.refuerzo: The message gives 7:30 as the start time, so this exact time is correct.
b5.o1.refuerzo: At seven leaves out the thirty minutes; the show starts at 7:30.
b5.o2.refuerzo: 18:00 is six in the evening, a different time from the 7:30 start.
b6.pregunta: How many nights is the hotel room booked for?
b6.o0.refuerzo: Two nights is the length of stay in the booking message, so it is correct.
b6.o1.refuerzo: One night is shorter than the booking; the room is reserved for two nights.
b6.o2.refuerzo: Three nights is more than the booking; the confirmation gives two nights.
b7.pregunta: By when should Ms Vega request a change?
b7.o0.refuerzo: The deadline is 10 July, so asking for a change before that date works.
b7.o1.refuerzo: 18 July is later than the deadline; the change must be requested before 10 July.
b7.o2.refuerzo: After 20 July is too late; changes must be requested before the deadline.
b8.o0.refuerzo: Incluido means included; breakfast included in the price fits the hotel message.
b8.o1.refuerzo: Adjunto means attached, used for files, not for a meal that comes with the room.
b8.o2.refuerzo: Cancelado means cancelled; the sentence says breakfast is included, not cancelled.
b9.traduccion: We confirm the booking for two nights.
